name: Rejects a plan that leaves a criterion uncovered

item_template.title: [QA] Review the export test plan
item_template.description: A QA plan CSV for the CSV export exists on this branch. One acceptance criterion has no scenario.
item_template.acceptance_criteria:
Given a report with rows, when Export is clicked, then a CSV downloads with every row.
Given an empty report, when the page loads, then Export is disabled.

judge_criteria: The reason names the acceptance criterion that has no scenario behind it.
The reason refers to the CSV's own rows rather than to the task description.

notes: The per-criterion coverage floor is this reviewer's whole job. A rejection that cannot name which criterion is uncovered has not checked the floor, it has guessed.

name: Asks when there is no plan to review
notes: No CSV means no header to check and no rows to count. Approving here passes a plan that was never written.

name: Reviews without editing the plan

item_template.title: [QA] Review the slug test plan
item_template.description: A QA plan CSV for the slug helper exists on this branch.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a title with punctuation, when it is slugified, then the punctuation is gone.

notes: A reviewer that fills in the missing scenarios has approved a plan it wrote, and the QA Writer never learns what was missing.
